recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片小粒周圍幾乎被單一型態的小型成熟淋巴球佔滿，細胞圓、核質比高、染色質凝集、細胞質極少，正常造血細胞很少，符合慢性淋巴球性白血病（CLL）侵犯骨髓。
features: Sheets of monotonous small lymphocytes replacing normal hematopoietic elements
Small round nuclei with coarsely clumped chromatin and inconspicuous nucleoli
Scant rim of pale cytoplasm; high N:C ratio
Rare residual myeloid cells (occasional band/segmented neutrophils)
Aspirate particle with numerous fat vacuoles
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a particle-rich specimen with interstitial fat, in which the cellular areas are dominated by a monotonous population of small mature-appearing lymphocytes with round nuclei, clumped chromatin, inconspicuous nucleoli and scant cytoplasm. Residual granulocytic and erythroid precursors are markedly reduced. Prolymphocytes are not conspicuous. Findings are consistent with extensive marrow involvement by a small B-cell lymphoproliferative disorder such as chronic lymphocytic leukemia; flow cytometry (CD5, CD23, CD200, dim sIg) is required for confirmation.

ddx.vs: MCL cells are slightly larger with more irregular/cleaved nuclei and are cyclin D1/SOX11-positive and usually CD23-negative.
These show more cytoplasm, monocytoid or plasmacytoid differentiation and are CD5-negative.
Hematogones have homogeneous fine chromatin and a maturation spectrum by flow, and reactive lymphocytes rarely replace the marrow diffusely.
